rulesExtracted.desc: Pick from default load table, not catalog
Explicit /si wins over table; same front door
Rewrite ask into card before tools; keep user words; fill gaps without inventing scope
Treating /si as spawn a swarm is anti-pattern
Hooks must stay deterministic, no extra LLM/network, fail open, <=3 skills
Do not pick from catalog / dump catalog
